mapper.select: SELECT s.support_id as supportId, s.user_id as userId, s.title, s.content, s.status, s.support_reason_id as supportReasonId, sr.reason_name as reasonName, sr.target_type as targetType, ( SELECT sa.content FROM SUPPORT_ANSWER sa WHERE sa.support_id = s.support_id ORDER BY sa.created_at DESC, sa.answer_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) as answerContent, NULL as answerAdminNickname, ( SELECT sa.created_at FROM SUPPORT_ANSWER sa WHERE sa.support_id = s.support_id ORDER BY sa.created_at DESC, sa.answer_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) as answerCreatedAt, NULL as answerHandlingMethod, s.created_at as createdAt FROM SUPPORT s JOIN SUPPORT_REASON sr ON s.support_reason_id = sr.support_reason_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SUPPORT ( user_id, title, content, status, support_reason_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{supportReasonId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT support_reason_id as supportReasonId, target_type as targetType, reason_name as reasonName, is_active as isActive FROM SUPPORT_REASON WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY support_reason_id ASC
SELECT support_reason_id as supportReasonId, target_type as targetType, reason_name as reasonName, is_active as isActive FROM SUPPORT_REASON WHERE support_reason_id = #{supportReasonId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUPPORT s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('[REPORT ', #{targetType}, ' ', #{targetId}, ']%')
SELECT faq_id as faqId, question, answer, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM ADMIN_FAQ ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT faq_id as faqId, question, answer, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM ADMIN_FAQ WHERE faq_id = #{faqId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_FAQ ( role_id, question, answer, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{roleId}, #{question}, #{answer}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ADMIN_FAQ SET question = #{question}, answer = #{answer}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE faq_id = #{faqId}
